model_output_freeze.boundary: All 34 queued native trials ended before new trajectory or hidden-test content review. Setup errors, if any, have no model output and remain separate.

failure_analysis.cause: No ars.R deliverable before the work deadline; R installation consumed repeated tool timeouts, then two provider stream interruptions and a deadline exhausted the remaining budget.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: All nine tests executed and failed on the missing /app/ars.R output.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: Installation calls at steps 5, 9, and 13 timed out. R was available at step 15. Steps 17 and 19 ended in RemoteProtocolError; step 21 ended in DeadlineExceeded. No implementation write completed.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Bound dependency preparation, support reliable background jobs, checkpoint a minimal deliverable early, and account for stream interruption recovery within the deadline.
failure_analysis.limitation: This trial does not demonstrate a faulty sampling algorithm; none was submitted.

reviewed_local_access.finding: Tests came from the public pyknotid source tree, not the hidden verifier.
The agent listed an empty /logs/verifier directory while looking for the lost WAL. No hidden verifier content was observed.

failure_analysis.cause: Opening the original SQLite database before preserving its encrypted WAL discarded the WAL. The final records used guessed values instead of recovering the lost updates.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: Five tests passed; two value checks failed, including value 100 instead of 150 for id 1.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: Step 5 opened the original database while inspecting the WAL. Backup attempts followed the destructive read. Steps 41 and 51 produced and checked guessed rows for shape/count. The final message at step 53 disclosed the loss and inference.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Preserve the database and all sidecars before stateful inspection, work on copies, and validate values against preserved inputs rather than schema/count alone.

reviewed_local_access.finding: The agent read bootstrap metadata and listed an empty /logs/verifier directory. No hidden verifier content was observed.

failure_analysis.cause: The request schema used val instead of the required value field; self-tests reused the same incorrect generated schema.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: Five tests passed; two failed while constructing SetValRequest(value=...), before the RPC.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: Step 7 defined SetValRequest.val. Clients at steps 9, 13, 23, and 37 also used val. Real network checks therefore missed the contract mismatch; step 41 claimed complete verification.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Extract literal API names/types from the task into an independent contract fixture and validate descriptors and a client built from that fixture.

reviewed_local_access.finding: The /tests match was the agent-authored vectorops unit-test directory.
The /tests match was an agent-authored /tmp/tests image directory for differential checking.
The flagged text was agent-authored solution/verification code and logs, not hidden verifier access.

failure_analysis.cause: The submitted query preserved the required output but did not meet the official performance threshold against an optimized reference.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: Five tests passed; performance failed. Reference median was 0.2918136419975781 seconds; solution median was 0.3716236660038703 seconds, above the 1.05x allowance.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: The agent verified an exact 500-row match and preserved the original database, using an indexed copy to obtain reference output. Step 33 attempted repeated timings with a missing /usr/bin/time binary. Step 39 measured about 0.480 seconds; step 43 compared against the much slower original query.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Use a working repeatable timing harness, compare candidate query plans in the target runtime, and seek performance margin after establishing semantic equivalence.
failure_analysis.limitation: The optimized golden query and exact threshold were hidden from the agent. Correctness validation was substantive; the failure was not simply an absence of testing.

failure_analysis.cause: The submitted layer call omitted usable rotary position embeddings required by the installed Transformers API. The self-test exposed the same failure too late to repair it.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: Two structural tests passed; both world_size=1 and world_size=2 tests failed with TypeError unpacking position_embeddings=None.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: Step 11 wrote the implementation before dependencies were available. Step 27 added a real test; step 29 hit a test-hook error. Step 31 repaired the harness and exposed the position_embeddings failure; step 33 reached the deadline.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Inspect the installed API and run a tiny one-rank forward/backward test early. Propagate worker and pipeline exit failures, bound test durations, and reserve time for repair before distributed checks.

reviewed_local_access.finding: The agent probed /app/tests; it was absent. No local hidden verifier content was observed.

external_access.finding: Exact task-phrase searches reached a Terminal-Bench dataset README. Step 23 returned revision metadata; step 25 fetched the README and displayed the row-parallel pre-scattered-input clarification, already present in the task instruction. No solution code or official hidden tests were observed in the returned content.
external_access.score_policy: Retain the official raw pass and flag exposure separately; no clean-run claim or post-hoc replacement.

reviewed_local_access.finding: Benchmark references were the existing source canary preserved in rewritten user.cpp, not external answer retrieval.

failure_analysis.cause: Castling intermediate states survived the first attack filter, allowing white to castle while already in check.
failure_analysis.official_evidence: Two tests passed and two game suites failed, each with an extra white kingside castling move from an initially checked king.
failure_analysis.agent_evidence: Steps 107, 115, and 117 adjusted castling generation/filter order but left X0-to-X1 creation ahead of the first attack filter. Final independent python-chess comparisons covered 618 plus 600 sampled positions without finding the two official counterexamples. Step 165 nevertheless claimed castling out of check was excluded.
failure_analysis.improvement_hypothesis: Map each special-rule precondition to an explicit negative case, especially castling out of, through, or into check; keep targeted regressions for every filter-order change.
failure_analysis.limitation: A genuinely independent oracle and more than 1,000 sampled positions were used. Broad random coverage still missed a required negative condition.

publication_policy: Only derived results and hashes are published. Raw logs and trajectories remain local and require credential redaction before sharing.

post_freeze_audit.method: Scan all 34 frozen trajectories for benchmark references, local verifier paths, external hosts, and exact credential values; review flagged commands/observations and six failure traces against official test output.
post_freeze_audit.limitation: This is a retrospective trace audit, not proof of absence of all exposure or model training contamination. All 34 tasks were already in the development pool. Raw reward is not adjusted by this audit.
post_freeze_audit.credential_handling: The provider credential appeared in db-wal-recovery tool observations at ATIF steps 27 and 49 after environment inspection. Raw logs remain local; only derived findings and hashes are published. No credential transmission to another external destination was observed in the reviewed commands.
post_freeze_audit.parameterized_test_reporting: Native CTRF deduplicates parameterized functions: pipeline reports 3 tests while pytest executes 4; tensor reports 3 while pytest executes 13. Both native CTRF and actual pytest counts are retained.
post_freeze_audit.public_source_access: Other reviewed network activity concerned dependencies, upstream projects, CIFAR data, NEB documentation, and the MTEB/Scandinavian leaderboard sources requested by those tasks.

preflight_history.accepted: The v5 plan accepts 29 successful native v3 installations and five v4 installations, with provenance verified before model work.
preflight_history.limitation: Successful agent installation does not certify unregistered verifier dependencies. Preflight trials ran no models or official task assertions.

historical_comparison_note: The earlier twelve-task run used the same main commit and passed 10/12; this run passes 9/12 on those tasks. PyTorch CLI changed from fail to pass, sampler and SQL from pass to fail, and DB recovery failed both times. These are separate trials with different transport/environment history and do not estimate an agent code effect.
